provisionalRecommendation.startGraceTimer: First valid approval; a rejection ends the decision immediately. A transport/error response is not a valid moderation decision.
provisionalRecommendation.onDeadline: Use the available valid full-policy decision if only one service decided. If no valid decision exists, return unavailable.
providers: TypeSafe Jev through the direct TypeSafe API, subject to access and calibration
provisionalRecommendation.reason: Retains the already-calibrated full app policy and adds a provider/route capable of evaluating the same custom questions. Avoid using the existing Jev-through-Cloudflare route as the independent service.

limitations: 52 approved observations are insufficient to establish a stable population p99; nearest-rank p99 equals the observed maximum.
Production data here is only Clef; there is no measured production latency distribution for direct TypeSafe Jev.
The eight-second current timeout censors slower responses: successful response times do not describe the entire latency distribution.

The correct future grace metric is the distribution of max(tA,tB)-min(tA,tB) on valid paired responses, including both approvals and content rejections, measured from request start using the same clock.
Different providers reduce common failure paths but do not guarantee independent classification errors or uptime.
recommendedCalibration: Tune provider-specific rules/thresholds against labeled harmless and unsafe examples, minimize false rejects subject to predeclared safety recall requirements, and evaluate each provider alone plus the combined veto policy on a fresh held-out set. Do not reuse Clef thresholds for Jev.

historicalCalibration.limitation: Contains repeated prompts and examples inspected during calibration; not an independent validation study.

changesMade: Read-only historical log query and local analysis; no model calls, deployment, calibration runs or configuration changes.
